description: Replace the nameservers for a domain in the authenticated account. **This is a full replacement, not an append** — the supplied list becomes the complete set of nameservers. Most TLDs require 2-13 entries. Setting custom nameservers disables Porkbun's free DNS hosting for the domain. Idempotent: applying the same NS list twice is a no-op. The list is applied as a set — the registry may return it in a different order, so do not expect `get_nameservers` to echo your ordering back, and do not treat a reordering as drift.

dry_run.description: If true, validate only — returns wouldSucceed without changing the nameservers.

nameservers.description: Full list of nameservers (e.g. `['ns1.example.com', 'ns2.example.com']`). Minimum 2, maximum 13.

name: update_nameservers
title: Update Nameservers
